\section{Method}\label{sec:method}
The adaptive estimator (AE) uses the symbol $s$ for a score.
\begin{equation}\label{eq:score}\tag{1}
s = x + y.
\end{equation}
An intentionally complex expression preserves nested mathematical evidence.
\begin{align}
\mathcal{L}(\theta) &= \sum_{i=1}^{n}\left\|f_{\theta}(x_i)-y_i\right\|_2^2 \\
&\quad + \lambda \int_0^1 \frac{\partial f_{\theta}(t)}{\partial t}\,dt.
\end{align}
The derivation does not establish general mathematical correctness.
